summary_rows.label: HGB W/T/L of CISO vs SMOTE
HGB Holm-corrected Wilcoxon p (CISO vs SMOTE)

outcome.stat_test: Friedman test (p: LR 0.0006, SVC 8.8e-10, RF 1.9e-08, HGB 0.0036) then Holm-corrected Wilcoxon signed-rank of CISO vs each method (Table 3, p.20; Sect 5.6)

win_claim.quote: CISO is statistically equivalent to SMOTE on precision-recall AUC, ranks second of eleven under gradient boosting, and completes every one of 11,460 fold-level evaluations without failure.

uncertain: Table 1 p.16 is a two-column layout; row pairing (left/right dataset blocks) inferred from text-extraction order, and the 19 left + 18 right = 37 count is consistent.
Column N1 is taken as minority count (Sect 3 defines N0>N1 majority/minority); Table 1 does not define N1 in caption (p.16).

Paper does not state whether KEEL files were used as distributed vs. re-binarized; recorded as repository-defined from KEEL names (p.15-16). Sect 5.1 says multi-class datasets are binarized by smallest-class-vs-rest, which may apply to some KEEL names (e.g. dermatology-6, car-good, winequality-red-4) (p.15).
Tuning-suite Table 2 has no minority count (N1) column; n_minority null (p.18).
UCI datasets: n_classes null for those binarized by smallest class (original class count not printed); n_minority null as Table 1 has no N1 for UCI (p.16).
Abstract says 'eleven competing methods' and 'across 45 datasets'; Table 3 lists CISO plus 10 baselines (p.1, p.20). Text claims 'ranks second of eleven' under HGB with 11 rows including CISO.
Metric choice: schema priority prefers G-mean, but G-mean is only a secondary metric and no G-mean results table was found; PR-AUC aggregate used (p.17, p.20).
notes: No per-dataset results table; outcome.rows empty. Per-dataset results not printed in the paper text read; no GitHub/supplement URL seen (only grep for 'github' and 'supplement' returned no hits). Table 6 (p.27-28) gives scale-suite (8 UCI) mean PR-AUC ranks for LR/RF/HGB (SVC omitted); SMOTE ranks 5.50 (LR), 4.50 (RF), 4.88 (HGB); CISO row not captured in this extraction pass. Table 4 p.22 component ablation, Table 5 certified fraction correlation also aggregate. Proposed method CISO = Certified Interpolation Safe Oversampling. Four classifiers: LR, SVC (RBF), RF, HGB. Preregistered protocol; 5 hyperparameters tuned once on the 5 tuning datasets (90 configs), Sect 5.5 p.17. Baseline implementations from imbalanced-learn defaults with k matched to CISO's k (p.16). Preregistered Q1 success criterion not met (p.20).
